export declare const HOME_PAGE_CONTENT_TYPE = "molis.home-page.v1";

export declare const HOME_PAGE_DRAFT_SCHEMA: SandboxSchema;

export declare const HOME_PAGE_LIMITS: {
    readonly files: 64;
    readonly fileBytes: number;
    readonly totalBytes: number;
};

export type HomeBasicSelection = {
    kind: "basic";
};

export type HomeGeneratedPageSelection = {
    kind: "page";
} & HomePageRef;

export interface HomePageApproval {
    page: HomePageRef;
    approved_actions: ExactActionReference[];
    approved_at: string;
}

export interface HomePageApprovalInput extends HomePageRef {
    approved_actions: ExactActionReference[];
    request_id: string;
    expected_revision: string;
}

export type HomePageApprovalOperation = (typeof approvalOperations)[number];

export interface HomePageApprovalReadQuery {
    by: "approval_request";
    operation: HomePageApprovalOperation;
    request_id: string;
}

export type HomePageApprovalReadResult = {
    kind: "receipt";
    receipt: HomePageApprovalReceipt;
    current: HomeSelectionState;
} | {
    kind: "missing";
    current: HomeSelectionState;
};

export interface HomePageApprovalReceipt<Operation extends HomePageApprovalOperation = HomePageApprovalOperation> {
    operation: Operation;
    request_id: string;
    selection: HomeGeneratedPageSelection;
    revision: string;
    approval: HomePageApproval;
}

export interface HomePageDiffInput {
    page_id: string;
    from_version: number;
    to_version: number;
}

export interface HomePageDiffResult extends HomePageDiffInput {
    files: Array<{
        path: string;
        kind: (typeof fileChanges)[number];
    }>;
    entry: {
        before: string;
        after: string;
    };
    actions: {
        added: ExactActionReference[];
        removed: ExactActionReference[];
    };
}

export type HomePageDirectDraftSaveInput = {
    draft: HomePageDraft;
} | {
    draft: HomePageDraft;
    page_id: string;
    expected_version: number;
    based_on?: number;
};

export interface HomePageDirectDraftSaveResult {
    version: HomePageVersion;
}

export interface HomePageDraft {
    title: string;
    entry: string;
    actions: ExactActionReference[];
    files: HomePageFile[];
}

export type HomePageDraftSaveInput = HomePageDirectDraftSaveInput | ContentAdoptionInput<HomePageDraft>;

export type HomePageDraftSaveResult = HomePageDirectDraftSaveResult | ContentAdoptionResult;

export interface HomePageFile {
    path: string;
    media_type: HomePageMediaType;
    text: string;
}

export interface HomePageFileMetadata {
    path: string;
    media_type: HomePageMediaType;
    bytes: number;
    sha256: string;
}

export interface HomePageFilesResult {
    version: HomePageVersion;
    files: HomePageFile[];
}

export type HomePageMediaType = (typeof mediaTypes)[number];

export interface HomePageOverview extends HomeSelectionState {
    versions: HomePageVersionSummary[];
}

export interface HomePagePreviewResult {
    page: HomePageRef;
    page_session_id: string;
}

export type HomePageReadInput = Record<string, never> | {
    queries: Array<ContentAdoptionQuery<HomePageDraft> | HomePageApprovalReadQuery>;
};

export type HomePageReadResult = HomePageOverview | {
    results: Array<ContentAdoptionReadResult | HomePageApprovalReadResult>;
};

export interface HomePageRef {
    page_id: string;
    version: number;
}

export interface HomePageSelectInput extends HomeBasicSelection {
    request_id: string;
    expected_revision: string;
}

export interface HomePageSelectResult {
    selection: HomeBasicSelection;
    revision: string;
    approval: null;
}

export interface HomePageVersion extends HomePageRef {
    title: string;
    files: HomePageFileMetadata[];
    entry: string;
    actions: ExactActionReference[];
    author: (typeof authors)[number];
    based_on?: number;
    created_at: string;
}

export interface HomePageVersionSummary extends HomePageVersion {
    approval: HomePageApproval | null;
}

export type HomeSelection = HomeBasicSelection | HomeGeneratedPageSelection;

export interface HomeSelectionState {
    selection: HomeSelection;
    revision: string;
}

export declare const homePageActions: {
    read: ActionDefinition<HomePageReadInput, HomePageReadResult>;
    saveDraft: ActionDefinition<HomePageDraftSaveInput, HomePageDraftSaveResult>;
    preview: ActionDefinition<HomePageRef, HomePagePreviewResult>;
    adopt: ActionDefinition<HomePageApprovalInput, HomePageApprovalReceipt<"adopt">>;
    restore: ActionDefinition<HomePageApprovalInput, HomePageApprovalReceipt<"restore">>;
    select: ActionDefinition<HomePageSelectInput, HomePageSelectResult>;
    diff: ActionDefinition<HomePageDiffInput, HomePageDiffResult>;
    readFiles: ActionDefinition<HomePageRef, HomePageFilesResult>;
};

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

declare const approvalOperations: readonly ["adopt", "restore"];

declare const authors: readonly ["assistant", "person"];

declare const fileChanges: readonly ["added", "modified", "deleted"];

declare const mediaTypes: readonly ["text/html", "text/javascript", "text/css"];
